sources.title: RM-Distiller: Exploiting Generative LLM for Reward Model Distillation
sources.snippet: Reward models (RMs) play a pivotal role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. Due to the difficulty of obtaining high-quality human preference annotations, distilling preferences from generative LLMs has emerged as a standard practice. sources.title: RM-Distiller: Exploiting Generative LLM for Reward Model Distillation
sources.snippet: Solely optimizing for discriminative signals can lead to re-ward over-optimization, where the model gradually loses its foundational understanding of language, which is essential for generalizability [Yang et al., 2024b]. Therefore, we pro-pose Generative Regularization to preserve the generative knowledge of the backbone model during distillation.
